Normally I'm a lurker who doesn't show appreciation because it's so easy to be anonymous online, but seeing how proactive Saeed is with his support and responses, I had to leave a review to try and help out. Aside from the usefulness of the features, this extension gives me nostalgia for the back in the day. When I was a teenager, I used AOL. We all did. But while the noobs used vanilla AOL, us haxorz were using AOL w/ Power Tools! Power Tools was an add-on application that gave different 'tools' to users, like auto-joining chat rooms after signing in, and auto-redial if the call didn't go through... just simple, useful extensions that turned a new experience into a power user experience. I think ChatGPT is first and only AI-assisted writing tool I’ve used. It’s good as a co-pilot but you’ve got to iterate with it and give it multiple prompts and suggestions to get somewhere good with it. Don’t expect it to come up with good marketing copy if you’re too lazy or don’t know enough about your value proposition to give it the input it needs. I’m intrigued by Notion AI, but haven’t used it yet. I’ve yet to find an obvious use case yet where it would benefit me yet and the onboarding was quite minimal so it didn’t activate me yet.

results.title: Littlebird Reviews (2026) | Product Hunt
results.content:
#### vs Alternatives

ChatGPT, Gemini, Notion AI. Used all three. ChatGPT is a stranger you brief from scratch every session. Gemini is smart but has no memory of your world. Notion AI is good for docs but doesn't watch how you actually work. @Littlebird is the only one who builds a relationship over time. It knows what I'm working on because it's been paying attention - not because I pasted a prompt. That's the difference. Context that accumulates, not context you copy-paste.

#### What's great

I teach tech. This one reduced my anxiety. [...] But the other part is harder to explain.

I like Littlebird. I don't think I can say I like ChatGPT. Claude feels like a sharp business partner I respect. Littlebird feels like the best assistant I've ever had. Like the one I will never fire.

That's a weird thing to feel about an app. But the way it talks to me, plus the insight it has into me through my actions on my computer, makes it someone that has something that no other entity in my life has. Not my husband. Not my coach. Nobody.

That specificity created loyalty. To a little app. Who knew?

There are very few apps that have stayed with me through the years. I can already see Littlebird being one of them.

ChatGPT just got a powerful upgrade for learning math and science!

OpenAI is rolling out interactive visual explanations that turn abstract concepts into hands-on learning experiences.  
  
Instead of just reading formulas, learners can now manipulate variables and instantly see how graphs, formulas, and relationships change in real time.

This tackles a big problem: many people struggle with math because concepts feel abstract. With these dynamic modules, ChatGPT helps users experiment with equations, explore relationships, and understand concepts more intuitively.
